craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of stated proof — design inference through lacunae; gaps sung as gaps; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Auspice half-verse sung whole (lacuna before it, not in it); who-makes/him-I-praise hammer. Rejected: (a) filling lost pādas → killed: complete-as-praise per UNC. Read aloud: WHO-makes — HIM, i-PRAISE … THE-one-GOD …

lines: the one God, Maheśvara the Lord.

reads_against.argmap: Under what auspice does the Lord's proof open? → Auspice: praise of the one maker-Lord whose proof follows.
c1_essence: Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2).
Variety marks wisdom; matter can't arrange; makers proved prove the Lord — answering neither-potter-nor-Lord with conscious-only pervasion shown (vv5-9).
